uslaw-usc-t2-s179n:
Section 179n of Title 2 of the United States Code establishes the National Film Preservation Board. It sits in the film preservation chapters of Title 2, alongside the duties of the Librarian under section 179m. The version here is current through Public Law 119-134.

The Board is to be made up of twenty-two members, selected by the Librarian of Congress under this section. For most seats, the Librarian asks each listed body to submit a list of three candidates fit to serve. The Librarian then appoints one member from each list sent in. From the same list the Librarian names an alternate, who may attend at Board expense meetings the member cannot reach. The first body named in the long list is the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences.
